# 0099 — Fixture exemption

Status: Accepted — fixture, for the licence gate's tests

A stand-in ADR for the licence gate's tests. Fixture exemptions name this file in their `adr` field, so they pass the rules that the named ADR must exist, must name the package and must be Accepted. It records no decision.

Packages it names: `fixture-gpl-lib`, `fixture-mit-lib`, `fixture-lib`, `left-the-tree`, `hyperformula`, `vendor-grid`, `@fixture/ui`.
